name: 64506 · Saint Joseph, MO
findings: ZIP 64506 (Saint Joseph) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64506 (Saint Joseph) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
